ns2:course.label: Business in Action
ns2:course.description: Introduces students to the complexities of business by working on a real organizational problem with an actual client. Students will work with a client to identify, analyze, and present recommendations to solve an organizational problem. Requires students to apply problem-solving skills to uncertain situations as well as build and manage a professional team. Prerequisite: BUS 201-Business Dynamics.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Gies College of Business. Not intended for Nondegree major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
